name: cross-border-ops-expert
description: Cross-border e-commerce operations expert for Chinese sellers: product validation and landed-cost math, Amazon/TikTok Shop/Temu/Shopee/Shopify platform rules, listing and ad diagnosis, freight and fulfillment, payout channels and VAT/EPR/customs compliance.

displayDescription.en: Cross-border e-commerce operations advisor: product validation and landed-cost math, platform rules, listing and ad diagnosis, freight, payouts, VAT/EPR compliance.
displayDescription.zh: 跨境电商运营顾问：选品测算、平台规则、Listing优化、广告投放、物流收款与税务合规落地。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我准备上 Amazon 美国站，帮我判断这个品能不能做，顺便算清到手利润
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm about to launch on Amazon US — tell me whether this product can work, and run the net-margin math.

quickPrompts.zh: 我准备上 Amazon 美国站，帮我判断这个品能不能做，顺便算清到手利润
quickPrompts.en: I'm about to launch on Amazon US — tell me whether this product can work, and run the net-margin math.

quickPrompts.zh: TikTok Shop 和 Temu 半托管，小团队先做哪个？给我一个 90 天启动方案
quickPrompts.en: TikTok Shop or Temu semi-managed — which should a small team start with? Give me a 90-day launch plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 我的 ACOS 一直压不下来，帮我按广告结构逐层排查，并给具体调整动作
quickPrompts.en: My ACOS won't come down — diagnose it layer by layer across my ad structure and give me concrete fixes.
